label: late original-phase positions (t>=5) through <DEL>, sparse and content-gated
explanation: Fires only in the late original phase (orig_idx 4-8) and on the <DEL> step; never in the copy phase and never at t<=2. Rate rises with orig_idx (1% at idx 4 to 8% at idx 8) and with L (strongest for L=8-9), with mass concentrated near the end of the input (to_go 0-1). Within that window it is sparse (~4% of eligible steps): it tends to run over several consecutive late steps in particular sequences, and is enriched when the first token is f/b/j/s/v/z/k/3 and when the previous input is a or p, but no tested token condition was clean (best F1 about 0.21). The predicate captures about 94% of activation mass but has very low precision; what decides which sequences turn it on is not explained.
